title: Forearm Self-Massage
summary: The free hand strokes and makes gentle circles over the opposite forearm.
goal: Gently unload the forearms after hand work.
startingPosition: Rest the forearm on a table or thigh.
warning: Stop self-massage with pain, numbness, weakness, dizziness, radiating sensations, or other unusual symptoms.
